final: SELECT AVG(qty) AS avg_quantity, AVG(share) AS avg_share, AVG(qty - avg_qty) AS avg_excess_over_per_color_average FROM (SELECT qty, qty * 100.0 / (SELECT SUM(qty) FROM (SELECT COALESCE(p.product_color, 'No Color') AS color, SUM(CAST(ili.product_quantity AS INTEGER)) AS qty FROM Invoice_Line_Items ili JOIN Products p ON ili.product_id = p.product_id GROUP BY p.product_color)) AS share, (SELECT SUM(qty) * 1.0 / COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT SUM(CAST(ili.product_quantity AS INTEGER)) AS qty FROM Invoice_Line_Items ili JOIN Products p ON ili.product_id = p.product_id GROUP BY p.product_color)) AS avg_qty FROM (SELECT SUM(CAST(ili.product_quantity AS INTEGER)) AS qty FROM Invoice_Line_Items ili JOIN Products p ON ili.product_id = p.product_id GROUP BY p.product_color) WHERE qty > (SELECT SUM(qty) * 1.0 / COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT SUM(CAST(ili.product_quantity AS INTEGER)) AS qty FROM Invoice_Line_Items ili JOIN Products p ON ili.product_id = p.product_id GROUP BY p.product_color)))
